---
name: Feature request or improvement
about: Ask for a change, a new cell, a tweak — anything you'd like TickerBar to do
title: "[Request] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like?**
Describe the change or improvement in your own words — no technical terms needed.

**Where in the bar?**
Which cell or part of TickerBar is it about (if any)?

**Anything else?**
Screenshots, examples, or "like the thing in the other bar" all help.
